code.note: Copied before any agent edited ask.js; both match git HEAD.

environment.realGemini: NOT MEASURED: App/.env does not exist, so there is no GEMINI_API_KEY. Every Gemini number below is the mock.
environment.mockModel: first token at 800 ms + 25 ms per 1,000 prompt tokens, then 600 characters/s; the mock answer is 241 characters. Assumptions, not Gemini measurements.

contextSections: STATIC FACTS (bell schedule, clubs note, meets vs games, spirit)
UPCOMING EVENTS (14 max, ended events dropped)
FIRST GAME FOR TEAMS WITH NOTHING IN 30 DAYS
CLUBS (all 76, up to 150 characters of purpose each)
notInContext: results older than 7 days (the Bell Game, 13-42 on 11-06, is invisible)
how-to for the app itself (Schoology connect, Spanish setting)

promptSize.sectionsNote: CLUBS merges the static clubs note, MEETS vs GAMES and SPIRIT vs SPORTS lines (1,051 chars) with the live 76-club list.

sourceFetchMs.method: curl, 2026-11-18 09:26 to 09:33 PT, 1 first fetch + 3 repeats per source
sourceFetchMs.note: The clubs endpoint took 112.6 s on a CDN miss. ask.js gives each source 5 s, so on a miss Felipe waits the full 5 s and then answers without clubs.

coldStart.method: 5 fresh dev-server processes (mock Gemini, live sources, CDN warm); the first question builds the context, the next 2 reuse it
coldStart.simulatedNote: FELIPE_FIXTURES=1 with every source delayed. 2600 ms is the observed Events CDN-miss time; 6000 ms passes the 5 s source timeout, so every section becomes UNAVAILABLE (prompt drops to about 6,800 chars) and the context cache drops to 30 s.

fullRun.method: 104 cases, dev-server.mjs URL mode, mock Gemini, live sources, legacy body { question, history } like the live app, x-felipe-now per case

studentTimeToFirstCharacter.explanation: The live app sends one non-streaming request and shows only the typing note until the whole JSON arrives, so first visible character = total time (plus network to Vercel).
studentTimeToFirstCharacter.formula: real first character = context build (about 0.03 to 0.2 s on a cold or expired cache when the CDN is warm, up to 5 s when it is not) + full Gemini generation (not measured) + network
